prompt:
If the action stops and later starts again, list the occurrences separately. If the action continues, keep it in a single interval.
Invented examples, unrelated to this video. Use only evidence in the supplied video for your answer.
- A dog barks, is silent for a while, then barks again: [[4, 8], [18, 22]].
- A chef chops onions continuously from 10 to 24 seconds: [[10, 24]].
examples_control: On A1, also replace only the continuous chopping example with the same chef stopping and restarting: A chef chops onions from 10 to 16 seconds, pauses, then chops again from 20 to 24 seconds: [[10, 16], [20, 24]].
baseline: Frozen E3 same query, pooled frames, timestamps, pixels, decoding, weights; compare both official 4B and A1@200.
primary: A1 balanced prompt vs plain, all 320 OMTG. Report strict original-pair splits with an additional event hit; replicate on 301 hold_multi. Official model evaluated with identical design.
singles: Each of hold_single 150 and Charades 300: original count=1 to new count>=2, paired tF1 and union IoU. Both metrics and both sets must lose at most 1 pp on A1 before launching a revisit.
trigger: Balanced 32-unit A1 predicts exactly one span longer than 15s, max timestamp gap including span edges >2s, >=32 unused distinct two-frame units fully inside (both frame times), U>=64. No GT used to trigger.
revisit: All queries one pass uniformly sampling up to 64 two-frame units with identical balanced prompt. Eligible queries additionally get two 32+32 policies: identical follow-up prompt with original predicted interval, either 32 local unused units or 32 unused global units. Only accept 2+ disjoint clipped intervals. Noneligible keep first answer. Separately compare full policies and trigger-only sets; record calls, model seconds and visual tokens.
second_stage_gate: Both single-set harm checks above and residual A1 OMTG coalescence after balanced prompt. Stage 2 uses frozen gate and trigger.
strict_resolution: At least one formerly enclosed adjacent pair now has two separate overlapping predictions, the number of hits in this pair increases and total one-to-one IoU>=0.5 hits in the query increases. Other merged pairs may remain.
historical: The earlier 100 examples used a different visual/prompt protocol; never use it as the cached baseline for this experiment.
